LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TI.label: solar neutronium condenser
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TI.description: A Solarite-engineered machine that draws neutronium from deep subsurface deposits, channeling vast solar energies to stabilize and accumulate the volatile matter. The foundation of any neutronium operation.
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TII.label: kwazaari neutronium condenser
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TII.description: A Kwazaari condenser employing kwazaari-lattice resonance to draw neutronium from the deep at twice the efficiency of solar designs. The exotic alloys within sustain extraction rates that no Solarite machine could match.
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TIII.label: tenebral neutronium condenser
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumCondenser_TIII.description: The pinnacle of Tenebral engineering. This condenser siphons neutronium from the deep with terrifying efficiency, its tenebrite core operating at the edge of known physical limits. Those who built it did not need to understand it - only to use it.
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumPipe.label: neutronium pipe
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumPipe.description: BOR_Sunsteel pipes designed to transport usable neutronium
LanguageData.BOR_UndergroundNeutroniumPipe.label: hidden neutronium pipe
LanguageData.BOR_UndergroundNeutroniumPipe.descriptio: Hidden Sunsteel pipes designed to transport usable neutronium
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumValve.label: neutronium valve
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumTank.label: neutronium tank
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumTank.description: An industrial liquid storage tank meant for storing neutronium delivered via neutronium pipe network. Tanks can be designated to be siphoned for usable neutronium as needed. If damaged even lightly the escaping fumes will very swiftly create a gaseous fireball, the size of the resulting explosion will depend on the amount stored within.
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumTap.label: neutronium tap
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumTap.description: A hopper-like storage basin meant to hold dispensed neutronium from tanks periodically for use later.
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumDrain.label: neutronium drain
LanguageData.BOR_NeutroniumDrain.description: A hopper-like storage basin meant to input neutronium into the network, filling up connected tanks.
LanguageData.BOR_InfiniteNeutroniumGenerator.label: tenebral neutronium selfsustained generator
LanguageData.BOR_InfiniteNeutroniumGenerator.descript: Slowly generates neutronium from particulate matter in the air.
